req.title: Task title accepts unicode
req.statement: The system shall accept task titles containing UTF-8 characters and return them intact.

doc.reasoning: The requirement specifies that the system should accept task titles containing UTF-8 characters and return them intact. This necessitates testing with valid UTF-8 input, invalid input, and boundary conditions to ensure robustness and compliance with the requirement.

tests.name: test_create_task_with_unicode_title
preconditions: The database is empty before the test.
actions: Send a POST request to /tasks/ with a task title containing UTF-8 characters.
expected: The response JSON contains the task title with UTF-8 characters intact.
tests.executable:
from app.main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

client = TestClient(app)

response = client.post(
    "/tasks/",
    json={"title": "Tâsk Tïtlê with Ünicode", "description": "A task with unicode title", "completed": False}
)

assert response.status_code == 201
assert response.json()["title"] == "Tâsk Tïtlê with Ünicode"

tests.name: test_create_task_with_empty_title
preconditions: The database is empty before the test.
actions: Send a POST request to /tasks/ with an empty task title.
expected: The response JSON contains a validation error for the title field.
tests.executable:
from app.main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

client = TestClient(app)

response = client.post(
    "/tasks/",
    json={"title": "", "description": "A task with empty title", "completed": False}
)

assert response.status_code == 422
assert "title" in response.json()["detail"][0]["loc"]

tests.name: test_create_task_with_max_length_title
preconditions: The database is empty before the test.
actions: Send a POST request to /tasks/ with a task title of maximum allowed length (100 characters).
expected: The response JSON contains the task title with 100 characters intact.
tests.executable:
from app.main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

client = TestClient(app)

max_length_title = "T" * 100
response = client.post(
    "/tasks/",
    json={"title": max_length_title, "description": "A task with max length title", "completed": False}
)

assert response.status_code == 201
assert response.json()["title"] == max_length_title
